adoption.rationale: The pinned validator comment and error text declare alphanumeric, hyphen, and underscore characters only. AgentPresetService passes the persisted workspace MCP integration slug through validate_mcp_command_config to this validator. The contract proves only exclusion of slash and backslash from values the exact function accepts; it does not claim security impact or validate slug generation.

contract.declared_domain: Any ASCII string of length 1 through 64 passed as the name argument to Tracecat's validate_mcp_server_name function. The source pattern accepts one or more characters from [A-Za-z0-9_-] and CPython's terminal-dollar behavior may additionally accept one final line feed; this theorem covers only exclusion of slash and backslash, not the full declared name language or slug-generation behavior.
contract.guarantee: Every string accepted by the pinned validate_mcp_server_name function excludes slash and backslash characters.
contract.input_source: Workspace MCP integration configuration supplies MCPIntegrationCreate.name. MCPIntegrationService normalizes it into the persisted MCPIntegration.slug; AgentPresetService later passes that stored slug as name to validate_mcp_command_config, which invokes validate_mcp_server_name.
